calls.statement:
SELECT s.format, COUNT(*) AS line_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS distinct_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS distinct_ids,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net, COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores,
  MIN(f.sale_date) AS mind, MAX(f.sale_date) AS maxd,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS staff_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND s.store_id < 999
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH base AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.store_key, s.store_id, f.staff_purchase_flag, p.category, f.net_amount, f.sale_date, f.channel_code
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND s.store_id < 900
)
SELECT
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) FROM base) AS receipts_all,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM base GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) > 1)) AS receipts_multi_store,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM base GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT staff_purchase_flag) > 1)) AS receipts_mixed_staff,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM base GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sale_date) > 1)) AS receipts_multi_date,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base WHERE category='ZZ Test') AS test_lines,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base WHERE net_amount <= 0) AS nonpos_lines,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base WHERE channel_code <> 'ST' OR channel_code IS NULL) AS nonST_lines,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM base WHERE category <> 'ZZ Test' AND NOT staff_purchase_flag GROUP BY 1 HAVING SUM(net_amount) <= 0)) AS nonpos_receipts

calls.statement:
SELECT cs.format AS store_format,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts,
       SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs  ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id < 900
  AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH mine AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS rc
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1),
ctl AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales_before_returns) AS net, SUM(receipts) AS rc FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
  WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS stores, SUM(m.net) AS mine_net, SUM(c.net) AS ctl_net, SUM(m.rc) AS mine_rc, SUM(c.rc) AS ctl_rc,
  SUM(CASE WHEN abs(m.net-c.net)>0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stores_net_diff, SUM(CASE WHEN m.rc<>c.rc THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stores_rc_diff
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c USING (store_id)
